title: Neural State Space Model
text: Simulate neural state-space model in Simulink, 2 inputs, 5 outputs, {Initial state} sets Initial state; {Model} sets the neural state space object, {Initial state source}, {Output state} adds external output state port and {Output state derivative/difference} adds external output state derivative port. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: u
ports.summary: Input of the neural state-space model scalar | vector

ports.name: x0
ports.summary: Initial state of the neural state-space model scalar | vector

ports.name: y
ports.summary: Output of the neural state-space model scalar | vector

ports.name: x
ports.summary: State of the neural state-space model scalar | vector

ports.name: dx
ports.summary: State derivative/difference of the neural state-space model scalar | vector

ports.name: z
ports.summary: Latent state of the neural state-space model scalar | vector

ports.summary: Latent state derivative/difference of the neural state-space model scalar | vector

params.values: Neural state space object idNeuralStateSpace(1,’NumInputs’,1,’NumOutputs’,2) (default) | idNeuralStateSpace object

params.values: Add external output state port off (default) | on

params.values: Add external output state derivative port off (default) | on
